variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick keeps the north gate shut by Mayor Halvard's order because of Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: The north gate is closed by order of Mayor Halvard. There are bandits on the north road. If you want through, you'll have to take it up with the Mayor himself.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: I told you, the gate stays shut. See Mayor Halvard.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Thank you, brave Adventurer. Brackenford is in your debt.

variants.specifics: Thrumm: Tullis at the town gate of Thrumm; the Golems of the Deep Halls are the trouble.

first.speaker: Tullis
first.text: Welcome to Thrumm, stranger! Mind your head. Warlord Gorran is waiting for you in the Great Hall, straight ahead.

again.speaker: Tullis
again.text: You call that armor? You won't last a day in the Deep Halls.

later.speaker: Tullis
later.text: Hail, brave Adventurer! All of Thrumm honors your valor!

variants.specifics: Tharn: Pelk keeps the north gate of Tharn, shut until Mayor Dremmel hands the player its key.

first.speaker: Pelk
first.text: Watch your step out on the walkways, stranger! The planks are rotten past the gate, and the Zombies come up out of the bog at night.

again.speaker: Pelk
again.text: Oh, and don't drink the water.

later.speaker: Pelk
later.text: The Mayor gave you his key? Then the north gate is open. Get going, and hurry!

variants.specifics: Durnath: Torbek at the north gate of Durnath, where the road runs toward Ostrigan's Black Spire.

first.speaker: Torbek
first.text: Greetings, stranger! Watch the sky on the north road. The Imps have been dropping on travelers all week.

later.speaker: Torbek
later.text: Durnath owes you, brave Adventurer. Thank you.

variants.specifics: Tullin: Bosk at the causeway gate, shut until Mayor Dask hands the player its key.

first.speaker: Bosk
first.text: Want to spend a night in the lockup? Then keep walking.

again.speaker: Bosk
again.text: Oh, one more thing. Nobody crosses the causeway. Not without a key.

later.speaker: Bosk
later.text: The gate's open! Get across the causeway and hurry, it'll be dark soon!

variants.specifics: Quorran: Gurt guards the door of Archmage Corvald's tower until the Archmage sends for the player.

first.speaker: Gurt
first.text: This here is the tower of Archmage Corvald! No visitors allowed, and that goes double for Imps. You're not an Imp, are you?

again.speaker: Gurt
again.text: Like I said, this is the Archmage's tower. No visitors.

later.speaker: Gurt
later.text: The Archmage says you can go up now! The door's open. Well, don't just stand there, hurry!

variants.specifics: Tor Vessa: Brask, guard at the main gate of Tor Vessa, proud of the fort and Lord Kessick.

first.speaker: Brask
first.text: Welcome to Tor Vessa, stranger! No army has ever taken this fort, and none ever will while Lord Kessick holds the pass!

again.speaker: Brask
again.text: Hmmm. Those boots won't last a week in this snow.

later.speaker: Brask
later.text: My mother wants me to come home and keep goats. Maybe I will.

variants.specifics: Kildrun: Gorm, the guard at the town gate of Kildrun, threatens the lockup, then praises the player once the Great Forge is won back.

first.speaker: Gorm
first.text: Watch yourself, stranger. Troublemakers in Kildrun end up in Warden Krugg's lockup!

again.speaker: Gorm
again.text: Move along, or it's the lockup!

later.speaker: Gorm
later.text: Hail, brave Adventurer! The fires of Kildrun burn again. Your valor will not be forgotten!

variants.specifics: Harrow Cross: Warden Krell keeps the jail by the east gate, and later the dead come down from Gallows Hill.

first.speaker: Warden Krell
first.text: Watch yourself in Harrow Cross, stranger. Start a fight at the inn and you'll be sleeping in my jail with the rats!

later.speaker: Warden Krell
later.text: The dead are coming down from Gallows Hill tonight! If you go out the east gate, go ready to fight.

variants.specifics: Vardo: Gorlen keeps the north gate of Vardo, shut by Mayor Brumhold until the Ogres are dealt with.

first.speaker: Gorlen
first.text: Hold it! Nobody goes out the north gate without Mayor Brumhold's permission. And keep that weapon put away while you're inside the village.

again.speaker: Gorlen
again.text: Nice day, isn't it? My beans could use some rain, though.

later.speaker: Gorlen
later.text: The gate is open. Watch yourself out there! Ogres have been seen all along the north road.
